title: Be accredited to auction as a licensed agent
what: As a real estate or stock and station agent, act as an auctioneer only if accredited as an auctioneer.

sources.title: Property and Stock Agents Act 2002 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: Every real estate agent's licence and stock and station agent's licence is subject to the condition that the holder of the licence must not act as an auctioneer unless the licensee is accredited as an auctioneer under this section

administration.who: NSW Department of Customer Service (the Secretary)

sources.title: Property and Stock Agents Act 2002 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.locator: s 21, words naming the body (found 19 Nov 2026) (version of 2025-02-03)
sources.quote: The Secretary may accredit the holder of a real estate agent's licence or stock and station agent's licence as an auctioneer if the Secretary is satisfied that the holder has such qualifications in connection with the conduct of auctions and the functions of auctioneers as the Secretary may approve from time to time by order published on the NSW legislation website.

reach.condition: if its agents conduct auctions of property or livestock

confidence_note: Quoted from the Open Australian Legal Corpus copy of the version shown (DECISIONS E-118); later changes not checked. NSW does not license general (chattel) auctioneers; the accreditation applies to real estate and stock and station agents. Reach and framework marks follow the WA requirement for this family; to check.
